annotations.text:
What changed

A is retired. The phallic read came from its construction, not its framing: one heavy shaft with a round cap, rising on a diagonal. Nothing survives that.

D keeps A's idea and removes the cause — the composition is horizontal, both lines are rules rather than strokes, and a perpendicular tick turns the gap into a measurement.

E and F are both B, given craft. E carves the margin out of solid form; F gives the approach a cadence. Neither floats a lone stick next to a box any more.

Where I'd land: E, then D.

E is the only one that is a composition rather than a diagram — solid, confident at 16px, and the closing channel is a genuinely good animation. It costs you legibility of meaning: it needs the wordmark to explain itself once.

D is the most articulate and the least striking. F is the most legible and the most conventional — it will always be read as a bar chart first.

Say which and I'll build it out: icon set, lockups, panel and widget redrawn around it.
